annotations.title: Create, change or delete a meeting slot

description:
[Positions] Bookable time slots of a meeting step: action create, update or delete (with start_at, duration_minutes, capacity, location, meeting_url, interviewer and panel). Changing start_at, duration_minutes, location or meeting_url of a booked slot e-mails its booked candidates the new details; deleting one cancels their bookings and e-mails them and the interviewers. dry_run=true lists the booked candidates who would be e-mailed, without writing anything. get_interview_definition include=slots lists the slots. Creating a slot e-mails nobody. start_at is ISO 8601 with the UTC offset of the user's time zone (2026-11-20T14:00:00+01:00) and not in the past.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

action.description: create a slot on a meeting step, update one, or delete one (its booked candidates are cancelled and e-mailed).

agenda.description: Agenda for the panel (company feature meeting_panels).

capacity.description: How many candidates can book it, 1 to 500 (default 1); not below the number already booked.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

dry_run.description: true: validate and answer the slot as it would be and the booked candidates who would be e-mailed, without writing anything.

duration_minutes.description: Length, 5 to 1440 minutes. Default on create: the step's meeting.duration_minutes, else 30.

interviewer_profile_id.description: Who holds the meeting (`profile_id` (list_users) of a user of the company); null = the position's recruiter.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

location.description: Address or room; null = the step's location.

meeting_url.description: Video link; null = the step's link.

note.description: Internal note, not shown to candidates.

panel_profile_ids.description: Needs the meeting_panels feature; hand-made slots only: up to 8 users (`profile_id` (list_users)) who attend besides the interviewer, who leads. Empty or null removes the panel; left out keeps it.

slot_id.description: update / delete: the slot (a slot `id` from get_interview_definition include=slots).

start_at.description: create (required) / update: when the meeting starts.

step_id.description: create: the meeting step (a step `id` from get_interview_definition include=process, type meeting).

name: manage_meeting_slot
